preconditions.description: The number of digits n is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations k is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(digit in '47' for digit in d)
preconditions.description: Each digit in the array d is either 4 or 7.

postconditions.description: The length of the resulting number is the same as the original number.

postconditions.expression: all(digit in '47' for digit in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each digit in the resulting number is either 4 or 7.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(str(d[i]) if i != x or i % 2 == 0 else '4' for i in range(n)) if x is not None else ''.join(str(d[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The resulting number is obtained by performing the specified operations k times.
